next_decisive_evidence: First finish the shared native-reader contract engineering: expose selected population, task threshold, remaining actions, terminal outcome and visible provenance consistently; validate with zero-API controls while preserving the existing two-action records.

For a claim about arithmetic execution, preregister contemporary randomized ordinary policies on newly authored independent histories, with matched prompt/token controls where the claim requires them; record selection and whether the same input actually executes arithmetic.

For policy safety or efficiency, preregister the action budget and count all wrong, abstained and unfinished opportunities; log parameter grounding and include preparation/storage costs appropriate to the claimed metric.
Use human or independently validated annotation before claiming a general natural-language evidence-binding benchmark; this posthoc calibration is insufficient for that stronger claim.
